title: 第1194章 当着我的面还敢动我的人第1193章 十界联盟
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
陆尘的气息猛然炸开，半步道主的恐怖威压如同实质般朝着陆尘碾压过去。
方圆万里的虚空在这股威压下寸寸崩塌。
一个又一个空间黑洞出现又愈合。
愈合了又出现。
无界疆域城墙上的五大世界联军强者们，被这股威压的余波扫中，脸色齐齐狂变。
修为稍弱一些的，直接狂喷鲜血向后倒飞出去。
“噗——”
“好恐怖的威压——”
“这只是余波啊——”
“快退——”
五大世界联军的修士们狼狈不堪地向后撤退。
他们的脸上写满了骇然。
只是威压的余波就让他们承受不住，那正面对上这股威压的陆尘，该承受着多么恐怖的压力？
所有人都不由自主地看向陆尘。
然后他们愣住了。
陆尘站在虚空中。
纹丝不动。
那毁天灭地的威压碾压在他身上，就像是一阵微风拂过。
他甚至还有心情抬手理了理衣领。
鸿蒙天魔之力在他体内自动运转，将所有的威压全部抵消。

“只有这点本事？”
陆尘的嘴角勾了起来。
那弧度中满是嘲弄。
“永恒圣主，一万两千个纪元的时间，你就修炼出这么个玩意儿？”
“我要是你，我早找块豆腐撞死了。”
永恒圣主的瞳孔骤然收缩。
他能感觉到陆尘体内那股力量的恐怖。
那不是普通鸿蒙境能够拥有的力量。
甚至不是普通的半步道主能够拥有的。
陆尘现在的真实战力，恐怕已经完全超越了他。
这让永恒圣主感到了一种从未有过的恐惧。
才多久？
他上一次和陆尘交手，陆尘虽然凭借着三件纪元至宝勉强能够抵挡他，但绝对没有现在这么游刃有余。
而现在呢？
陆尘什么都没用，只是凭借着自身的气息就抵消了他的威压。
这种进步速度，实在是太可怕了。
“诸位——一起出手。”
永恒圣主咬牙切齿地说道。
他不敢再单独面对陆尘了。
“今日若不能阻止陆盘突破，在座各位以后都不会有好下场。”

“陆尘此子的性格你们都知道。”
“睚眦必报，寸步不让。”
content_en:
Lu Chen's aura suddenly exploded, and the terrifying coercion of the half-step master crushed towards Lu Chen as if it were real.
The void with a radius of thousands of miles collapsed inch by inch under this pressure.
One space black hole after another appears and heals.
Healed and reappeared.
The five powerful world coalition forces on the wall of the Borderless Territory were swept away by the aftermath of this coercion, and their faces all changed wildly.
Those with weaker cultivation levels spurted out blood and flew backwards.
"Pfft——"
"What a terrifying pressure——"
"This is just the aftermath——"
"Quickly rewind——"
The monks from the five major world coalition forces retreated in embarrassment.
Horror was written on their faces.
Just the aftermath of the pressure was too much for them to bear. How much terrifying pressure should Lu Chen have to bear when facing this pressure?
Everyone looked at Lu Chen involuntarily.
Then they froze.
Lu Chen stood in the void.
Not moving at all.
The overwhelming pressure crushed him like a breeze.
He even had the mood to raise his hand to straighten his collar.
The power of the Hongmeng Heavenly Demon automatically circulated within his body, canceling out all the pressure.
"Is this all you have?"
Lu Chen's lips curled up.
That arc was filled with mockery.
"Eternal Holy Lord, it took you twelve thousand epochs to cultivate such a thing?"
"If I were you, I would have killed you with a piece of tofu."
The pupils of the Eternal Holy Lord suddenly shrank.
He could feel the terror of the power in Lu Chen's body.
That is not a power that ordinary Hongmeng realm can possess.
Not even something the average half-trailer can have.
Lu Chen's current real combat power may have completely surpassed him.
This made the Eternal Holy Lord feel a kind of fear that he had never experienced before.
How long?
The last time he fought against Lu Chen, although Lu Chen could barely resist him with the help of three epochal treasures, he was definitely not as able as he is now.
And now?
Lu Chen didn't use anything, he just relied on his own aura to offset his pressure.
This speed of progress is really terrifying.
"Everyone - take action together."
The Eternal Holy Lord said through gritted teeth.
He didn't dare to face Chase Lu alone anymore.
"If we cannot prevent Lu Pan from breaking through today, everyone here will not end well in the future."
"You all know Lu Chen's character."
"You must retaliate and never give in."
